frozenPolicy: Set from the measured baseline before any selector change. These thresholds must not be relaxed to accommodate a later result.

derivation.reasoning: Every harmonic-active bar already has a generated candidate window and dedup removes none of them, so nothing about candidate generation caps what selection can reach. The full 90% target therefore applies without relief.

gates.note: Sections are derived from four-bar chroma novelty; the definition is frozen alongside this gate so the denominator cannot drift.
Bars 33-46 must be covered by at least one selected candidate, fully or partially.

guardrails.note: Coverage must not be bought by admitting weak candidates.
Coverage work must not move chord detection accuracy; those gates stay as frozen in Phase 4.0.

denominator.definition: bars in which chord-evidence notes sound
denominator.silentBars: excluded from both numerator and denominator
denominator.drumOnlyBars: excluded; they carry no harmony to cover
denominator.belowEvidenceThreshold: excluded by the same evidence selection the analyzer uses
denominator.pickupAndIncompleteBars: counted as ordinary bars when evidence notes sound in them
denominator.meterChanges: the analyzer uses the first time signature; this corpus is 4/4 throughout
